# InarizakiCheerCover

Made for HelpGrandmaOut; Hackclub

**Instructions** Hello! Welcome to "InarizakiCheerCover". This is essentially a rough cover of the Inarizaki cheer from the show "Haikyuu"; my favourite, that I created with code using the software "Strudel." I learned how to use this tool through the Hack Club program "Aria" and decided to create another project on it for another program. The prompts I was given were; "A hard size cap for your category: about 500 lines of code or 10 components, The README is readable by a non-programmer, Only two colors in the whole visual output." Moreover, how the code works is whenever it says "$: note" that means the letters and numbers represent the note in music alongside the octave, if it says "$: sound" that means its a sound for a drum/drum part, ".sound("")" is what sound/ instrument should be used for the code written in that line(s), "pan(0).color("")" just changes the colour of the box that shows what sound is currently playing. ".lpf, .room, and .delay" are just effects that are put on the sound such as reverb etc. Anyways, To use it: click on the link below and it should take you to the code. In order to play it, click anywhere so the typing line appears and press ctrl + enter, to stop ctrl + "." If you want to add on or change or learn how to use strudel I advise that you go through the Strudel tutorial which you can do by clicking "learn" in the top right corner when you go on my song. Enjoy!
